definitions.gloss: to pluck; to strum softly (a stringed instrument with the fingertips)
definitions.explanation: To play a guitar, shamisen, or similar instrument softly with the fingers, often casually or for oneself.

examples.japanese: ⟦ギター→ギター：04461_gitaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{爪弾|つまび}く。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三味線|しゃみせん}→三味線：04464_shamisen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{爪弾|つまび}いた。

⟦{縁側|えんがわ}→縁側：04495_engawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}って→座る：00757_suwaru⟧、⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦ギター→ギター：04461_gitaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{懐|なつ}かしい→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{爪弾|つまび}いて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He sat on the veranda, picking out an old favorite on his old guitar.

notes:
From ⟦{爪|つめ}→爪：02159_tsume⟧ (nail) + ⟦{弾|ひ}く→弾く：02444_hiku⟧ (to play a stringed instrument). Descriptive and slightly literary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ギター→ギター：04461_gitaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{爪弾|つまび}く: to pluck a guitar
- ⟦{三味線|しゃみせん}→三味線：04464_shamisen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{爪弾|つまび}く: to play the shamisen softly
- ⟦{弦|げん}→弦：18409_gen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{爪弾|つまび}く: to pluck the strings

WATCH OUT:
The noun {爪弾|つまはじ}き, written with the same kanji, means being shunned: ⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{爪弾|つまはじ}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be ostracized by one's peers).
